## Labels

Exactly one phase, one type, one size, and one or more area (`docs/KANBAN.md`). This template applies `type:feature` and `phase:1` (current). Add area and size; change phase if this is not Phase 1.

- Phase: `phase:1` (chat sidekick) | `phase:2` (live AR, ML, telemetry) | `phase:3` (garage projector)
- Area: `area:ios` | `area:ml` | `area:telemetry` | `area:rag` | `area:highlight` | `area:docs`
- Size: `size:S` (under a day) | `size:M` (one to three days) | `size:L` (split before Ready)

## Notes

- UI work needs PR screenshots for light, dark, and large Dynamic Type.
- Never invent vehicle facts. Cite `docs/MANUALS.md` (doc ID + page) or `docs/vehicle/TRUCK.md`. Unknowns are TBD.
- Blocked on truck delivery: leave in Backlog with a `TBD: delivery` note.
